acceptance_criteria: The visible behavior or data change is implemented.
proposal.impact: Who or what benefits from this task.
proposal.proposed_change: The smallest coherent change that addresses the problem.
rejection_conditions: Reject if the task cannot be proven without broad manual judgment.
Reject if it overlaps heavily with already active work.
required_proof: Relevant visual probe, screenshot, or textual inspection evidence.
proposal.why_now: Why this should be prioritized now.

parallel_safety.notes: Concrete collision notes; avoid broad categories.
safe_parallel_neighbors: Tasks touching unrelated data files or separate UI panels.
shared_state_risks: Any global singleton, data file, generated asset path, or test fixture likely to collide.
